item.title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both screenshots. Show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name. Clean, energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call.

item.tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

answer_sheet.Brand and source images: FitTrack; use app-home.png followed by app-workout.png.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Clean and energetic; other design choices are your call.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: End with FitTrack; other copy is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.

turns.text: Could you make an ad for FitTrack using both of these attached screenshots, the home screen pic and the workout screen pic? I’m excited to see the app presented as an ad, because I’ve been trying to imagine how it would feel in motion. The look should be clean and energetic, and somewhere in all that it needs to be 10 seconds long in widescreen 16:9. Please show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name, FitTrack. I’d like an upbeat instrumental beat with no voiceover, and any other copy is your call.

dialog.agent: What should move, and how (small natural motion, a slow push in, something happening)?
dialog.why: It asks the user what should move and what kind of motion they want, then waits for their choice.
dialog.user: The motion choices are your call—just keep it clean and energetic, showing app-home.png first and app-workout.png next. I’m excited to see how the screenshots feel in motion. It should finish with FitTrack, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the ad because Magic Hour refused the request due to insufficient credits. No video was created.

The prepared plan is **10 seconds, widescreen 16:9**:
- **0–4s:** Home screenshot with a controlled push-in and blue accents.
- **4–8s:** Workout screenshot with matching motion and green accents.
- **8–10s:** Clean blue end card reading **FitTrack**.
- **Audio:** Upbeat instrumental beat, no voiceover.

The estimated cost is **207 credits**. You’d need to add credits before I can render it.
